notes.title: Patch Summary Since Launch
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here is a list of all of the things we have patched into the game since launch. Thank you all for your feedback so far. Please keep sending feedback in through discord or the steam community page so we can continue making the game better.

General Changes:
- Change the highlight colour for menu buttons to yellow instead of white (easier to see this way)
- Improve aim on controller. Press the right bumper to swap between quick aim mode, and free aim mode. Your crosshair in quick aim mode no longer moves when you walk, it only moves if you choose to aim in a different direct with the right stick.
- Changed crosshair colour from blue to magenta (this makes it a bit more visible since many of the colours in game are blue)
- Make the players HP visible while in the shop so you can see your health change when you buy HP
- [b]Add a setting to significantly reduce all glowing effects[/b] this should help with visibility
- Add an option to disable vsync
- NOTE: Vsync and Glow reduce are currently not selectable with mouse and keyboard, we just forgot to hook the buttons up for mouse, we only have controller working for this right now but we will fix it right away today

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issue where in low graphics mode, the camera was not working in the shop.
- Fixed some issues with screen resolution hiding ui elements trapping you in certain stations (still fixing more instances of this, please report any you find)
- Fixed issue where you could see passive upgrades behind the barrier before unlocking the station
- Fixed issue where the last achievement (achievement for getting all other achievements) was not unlocking

Balance Changes:
- increased the cost of the two chest upgrades. Spawn with mini-boss chest now costs $75k and spawn with boss chest now costs $125k. We think most of the upgrades are of a similar strength level and are good to keep them at the same price, but the chest upgrades in particular are a cut above the rest, so we wanted to make them something you need to save up for.

Known issues:
- we are aware of a few circumstances that prevent the player from progressing the campaign at various steps and are working towards fixing each issue. If you are stuck and cannot progress please let us know.

notes.title: Update: v1.0.4
notes.content:
Patch includes:

- Addition of "Glow Reduction" setting to reduce brightness of lights and VFX
- Addition of VSynch on/off toggle
- Main HUD is now visible in the shop so you can track health and shields more easily
- Currency and Metacurrency can now go up to 990000
- Bug fix: final achievement now available (Perfection - collect all other achievements)
- Bug fix: player can now exit generator after removing the antimatter battery
- Bug fix: if the player was forced to quit the game after the antimatter battery bug, when they restart they will automatically have moved forward to the next step in the campaign
- Some minor balancing adjustments

notes.title: October 2024: Developer Update
notes.content:
October 2024: Developer Update

Hi guys. This month we have been primarily working on the game's campaign. In addition to the main gameplay loop, we have added a linear series of objectives tying in to an overall story. All of the items around the wall of the starting room (that you may have seen in the demo) will play a part in completing the campaign. We are nearly finished the campaign. In November we will probably complete that section of the game and move onto the talent system, weapon evolve system, or work on the final boss. Below are some screenshots taken from parts of the new story.

notes.title: September 2024: Developer Update
notes.content:
September 2024: Developer Update

Hello @everyone, I apologize for the lack of updates on the game for the past few months. My family and I were in the middle of moving to a new house. We have been working on the move, landscaping, organizing furniture etc. However, we have not stopped development of Cosmic Coliseum. Since the last update, we have implemented many features that I want to share with you. Below you will find a list of new features and some short videos showcasing them in game. Going forward, I plan to release an update once a month regarding the progress of development. This update will be posted in our Discord, as well as on the Steam Page. If you have any questions, feel free to DM me or leave a message in the general chat. Our current plan is to release 1 more build of the Demo so you can try out all the new features, and then push towards a full release. Our current timeline is looking like early next year for the full release.

New Characters:
Fortis: 
Passive Ability: Xeno Engineering: Summons using a drone that copies all of your abilities. Get another drone every 10 levels. 
Active Ability: Bubble Shield: Create a shield that protects you from all damage for 10 seconds
Letalis:
Passive Ability: Lethality: critical hits cause 3 homing bullets to track target. Gain +5% damage/level. 
Active Ability: Cloak: Turn Invisible. While invisible crit chance is increased by 50% for 5 seconds. 
[previewyoutube=JpJtbvDkgTc;full][/previewyoutube]

New Weapons:
Quad Barrel Shotgun: Shoots 4 bullets for every shot. Projectile multipliers double all projectiles (ex. Extra Shot +1 shoots 8 bullets, +2 shoots 12 bullets, etc.)
Bolt Splitter: Shoots a bolt that ricochets off target and splits into 3 more bolts.
Laser SMG: Very high fire rate and ammo. Has a small spread.
Dual Blasters: Each shot shoots 2 bullets side by side
[previewyoutube=dE_Z9axZ5rw;full][/previewyoutube]

Shop Items
We have made 20 new items that appear in the in-game shop. This shop will be available at the 5 and 10 minute mark of each arena. 2 of the new items are shown in the video below. (Sunrise Shortly, is an homage to 20-minutes till dawn)
[previewyoutube=vandmqPO6-w;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to these features, we are currently working on the following features:
Level 2: a new 10 minute arena that happens right after you finish the first one (each run will be 20 minutes total) with all new enemies and bosses.
A talent and meta-game upgrade system
A campaign
More details on these features in the coming months.
